translation:
If blood accumulates within and there is vomiting of blood, use Four Substances Decoction (四物湯) with added bupleurum (柴胡) and scutellaria (黃芩). In all cases of injury where one overexerts with toil, or where anger causes distension and oppression of the abdomen, or where excessive taking of cold and poisonous medicines injures the yang collaterals (陽絡), then there is spitting of blood, nosebleed, blood in the stool, and blood in the urine; when the yin collaterals (陰絡) are injured, then there is accumulation of blood, blood masses, and blue-black discoloration of the flesh. These all arise from deficiency and impairment of the viscera and bowels, and loss of function of the channels and passages; urgently supplement the spleen (脾) and lung (肺) viscera, and it will heal of itself. <ins>Modified Free and Easy Powder (加味逍遙散)</ins>
Atractylodes (白朮), poria (茯苓), dang gui (當歸), white peony (白芍, each two qian), bupleurum (柴胡, one qian), mint (薄荷, five fen), charred gardenia (黑梔), moutan bark (丹皮, each one and a half qian)
Decoct in water and take.
